name: Prague Christmas Markets (Old Town Square and Wenceslas Square)
blurb: Giant tree, wooden stalls and mulled wine on Old Town Square, plus a second market on Wenceslas Square; open daily into January.
priceText: Free entry; food and drink typically EUR 15-20 per person
when: Usually from the last weekend of Nov to 6 Jan, about 9:00-22:00 daily; 2026 dates not yet published

name: AC Sparta Praha v FK Mladá Boleslav (Chance Liga)
blurb: Saturday-evening league game at Sparta's epet ARENA on Letná hill; a cheap way to see Czech top-flight football.
priceText: CZK 350-1,200 depending on match category and sector (cheapest listed CZK 350)
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026, 18:00 (league round 17)

name: SK Slavia Praha v FC Slovan Liberec (Chance Liga)
blurb: Sunday-evening home game of Prague's other big club at the Fortuna Arena in Eden; kick-off 18:00.
when: Sun 13 Dec 2026, 18:00 (league round 18)

name: Vienna Christmas Market at the City Hall (Rathausplatz)
blurb: Vienna's largest Christmas market on the Rathausplatz, with stalls, hot punch and an ice-skating rink in the park alongside.
priceText: Free entry; skating at the Ice Dream rink is extra

name: Christmas Market at Schönbrunn Palace
blurb: Over 90 huts in the palace's front courtyard, with ice-stock shooting, a crafts hut and a nativity display; pretty when lit at night.
priceText: Free entry; ice-stock shooting and activities extra
when: 6 Nov 2026-6 Jan 2027; daily 10:00-21:00 until 23 Dec (24 Dec until 16:00)

name: SK Rapid Wien v LASK (Bundesliga)
blurb: Saturday-evening league match at Rapid's Allianz Stadion in Hütteldorf, one of Vienna's liveliest football atmospheres.
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026, 19:30 (league fixture list; time may change)

name: Advent Bazilika Christmas Market (St. Stephen's Basilica)
blurb: Four-time 'Europe's Most Beautiful Christmas Market' winner, set on Szent István Square in front of St Stephen's Basilica.

name: Budapest Christmas Fair at Vörösmarty Square
blurb: Classic downtown Christmas fair with craft stalls, Hungarian street food and mulled wine on Vörösmarty tér.
when: Usually mid-Nov to 31 Dec (2025: 14 Nov-31 Dec), about 11:00-21:00; 2026 dates not yet out

name: Ferencváros v Puskás Akadémia (NB I)
blurb: Monday-night league game of Hungary's most successful club at the Groupama Aréna.
when: Mon 14 Dec 2026, 19:30 (league fixture list; time may change)

name: Bratislava Christmas Markets (Bratislavské Vianoce)
blurb: Christmas market on the Main Square plus Franciscan and Primate's squares; opens with the tree lighting and feels small and local.
when: 27 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027 (Main Square, Franciscan Square, Primate's Square)

name: ŠK Slovan Bratislava v Shakhtar Donetsk (UEFA Champions League)
blurb: Champions League league-phase night at Tehelné pole; tickets sell through the club app, so book early.
priceText: Kotol EUR 48, III. cat. EUR 50, II. cat. EUR 110, I. cat. EUR 175; no discounts for European home games
when: Wed 9 Dec 2026, 18:45 (league phase, matchday 6)

name: ŠK Slovan Bratislava v Dunajská Streda (Niké liga)
blurb: Saturday-afternoon league game at the national stadium, far cheaper than the Champions League nights.
priceText: EUR 12 (home-fan sector), EUR 16 / 20 / 33 by category; discount cards only for children, pensioners, disabled
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026, 15:30 (Niké liga round 18)

name: Amsterdam Light Festival 2026-27
blurb: Light artworks along the canals, seen free on foot or from a canal cruise; lit every evening from late November.
priceText: Free to see from the street; Light Walk app EUR 6.99; canal cruises from EUR 29.75 (children 4-12 half price)
when: 26 Nov 2026-17 Jan 2027, lights on daily 16:30-23:00 (31 Dec until 21:00)

name: Ajax v SC Cambuur (Eredivisie)
blurb: Sunday-night league game at the Johan Cruijff ArenA; the club's page showed only last tickets in October.

name: Ajax v Getafe (UEFA Conference League)
blurb: European night at the Johan Cruijff ArenA; single tickets showed sold out on Ajax's site, with official resale open.
when: Thu 17 Dec 2026, 21:00 (league phase, matchday 6)

name: Winter Wonders Brussels (Plaisirs d'Hiver)
blurb: Brussels' winter festival with hundreds of Christmas chalets from Place Sainte-Catherine to the Bourse, plus shows, attractions and lights.
when: 27 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027 (programme details due from November)

name: RSC Anderlecht v TSG Hoffenheim (UEFA Europa League)
blurb: Europa League night at the stadium of Brussels' most successful club; tickets are sold through the club.
when: Thu 10 Dec 2026, 18:45 (league phase, matchday 6)

name: RSC Anderlecht v Charleroi (Belgian Pro League)
blurb: Sunday-lunchtime league game at the Anderlecht stadium, three days after the Europa League night.
when: Sun 13 Dec 2026, 13:30 (league fixture list; time may change)

name: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland
blurb: London's giant festive fair in Hyde Park: 150+ attractions, rides and shows plus bars and food; entry is cheap, extras add up.
priceText: Entry up to GBP 9.50 per person online (free if you add GBP 25 of rides or food; off-peak slots from GBP 1); rides and food extra
when: 19 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027, daily; timed entry slots

name: Christmas at Kew
blurb: Evening light trail through Kew Gardens; timed tickets, and popular dates sell out.
priceText: Adult GBP 29.50 off-peak, GBP 37 peak (members from GBP 25.23); child GBP 20-24
when: 13 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027, about 16:20-22:00 (closed 25 Dec and some Nov dates)

name: Arsenal v Real Madrid (UEFA Champions League)
blurb: Champions League league-phase night at the Emirates; expect extremely high demand for tickets.
when: Wed 9 Dec 2026, 20:00 UK time (21:00 CET); league phase, matchday 6

name: Tottenham Hotspur v Arsenal (Premier League)
blurb: North London derby at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium; the date is in the fixture list, kick-off time still to be set.
when: Weekend of 5-6 Dec 2026 (listed Sat 5 Dec; kick-off time to be confirmed)

name: Edinburgh's Christmas (Princes Street Gardens market, Big Wheel, George Street ice rink)
blurb: Market in East Princes Street Gardens by the Scott Monument, with the Big Wheel and an undercover ice rink on George Street.
priceText: Free to enter the market; Big Wheel and ice rink are ticketed

name: Hibernian v Rangers (Scottish Premiership)
blurb: Saturday-afternoon league game at Easter Road against one of Scotland's big two.
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026, 15:00 (league fixture list; TV selection may move it)

name: Heart of Midlothian v Borac Banja Luka (UEFA Conference League)
blurb: Thursday-night European game at Tynecastle Park, home of Hearts.
when: Thu 10 Dec 2026, 20:00 UK time (21:00 CET); league phase, matchday 5

name: Celtic v Hibernian (Scottish Premiership)
blurb: Sunday-afternoon league game at Celtic Park; tickets can be hard to find, so look early.
when: Sun 13 Dec 2026, 15:00 (league fixture list; TV selection may move it)

name: Glasgow's Winter Wonderland (Glasgow Green ice rink; St Enoch Square rides)
blurb: Ice rink on Glasgow Green with timed 45-minute sessions and boots included; rides are reported at St Enoch Square.
priceText: Free to enter the site (per a third-party guide); ice skating is ticketed, price shown at booking
when: Ice rink 20 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027 (selected sessions); St Enoch rides reported 6 Nov-27 Dec

name: Manchester Christmas Markets
blurb: Markets across ten city-centre sites; Albert Square (big wheel, helter-skelter) and Cathedral Gardens (ice rink) stay open longest.
priceText: Free entry; rides and ice rink extra
when: 6 Nov-22 Dec 2026; Albert Square and Cathedral Gardens until 3 Jan 2027

name: Manchester City v Chelsea (Premier League)
blurb: Saturday clash at the Etihad Stadium; the club's page listed only hospitality as on sale in October.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026, 15:00 UK time (club lists date and kick-off as subject to change)

name: Manchester United v RB Leipzig (UEFA Champions League)
blurb: Champions League league-phase night at Old Trafford; expect very high demand for tickets.
when: Tue 8 Dec 2026, 20:00 UK time (21:00 CET); league phase, matchday 6

name: The Warehouse Project: FAC51 The Haçienda night
blurb: Big one-off club night at Depot Mayfield: house and techno legends with the Haçienda's name; runs 17:00 to 03:00.
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026, 17:00-03:00 (Depot Mayfield)

name: TwinkleTown, Dublin's Christmas Festival (Smithfield Square and St Patrick's Park)
blurb: Free-entry festival at two city sites: ice skating, big wheel, craft market, a panto, and a lights-and-choir setting in St Patrick's Park.
priceText: Free entry; ice skating, Big Wheel, panto and rides are ticketed
when: Smithfield Square 20 Nov-31 Dec; St Patrick's Park 27 Nov-23 Dec

name: Christmas with the Choir of Christ Church Cathedral
blurb: Choir concert in Dublin's medieval Christ Church Cathedral on three December evenings, about an hour long from 20:30.

name: Leinster v Sale Sharks (Investec Champions Cup, round 2)
blurb: Champions Cup pool game for Dublin's best-known rugby club; the schedule lists the date but the venue is still to be named.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026, 17:30 (venue to be confirmed)

name: Tuileries Christmas Market and Champs-Élysées Christmas Market
blurb: Chalets, rides and treats in the Tuileries Garden, with a second market on the Champs-Élysées just next door.
priceText: Free entry; rides and food extra
when: Tuileries reported 14 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027; organiser dates not yet confirmed

name: Paris Saint-Germain v Paris FC (Ligue 1)
blurb: Saturday league game at the Parc des Princes against the other Paris club; kick-off time to be set by the league.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (Ligue 1 matchday 14; kick-off time to be confirmed)

name: Paris Basketball v Real Madrid (EuroLeague)
blurb: EuroLeague night for the Paris club against Real Madrid; the league lists the Adidas Arena, but check the club for the final venue.
when: Thu 10 Dec 2026, 20:45 (round 16)

name: Paris Basketball v Olympiacos (EuroLeague)
blurb: EuroLeague game for the Paris club against Olympiacos; check the club site for the arena and tickets.
when: Tue 15 Dec 2026, 20:45 (round 17)

name: Fête des Lumières (Festival of Lights)
blurb: Four nights when Lyon is lit by projections, installations and candles in windows; free, very crowded, and the signature December event.
when: Sat 5-Tue 8 Dec 2026, evenings

name: Lyon Christmas Market, Place Carnot
blurb: The city's traditional Christmas market at Place Carnot, with craft and solidarity stalls.
when: 20 Nov-24 Dec 2026

name: Olympique Lyonnais v Olympique de Marseille (Ligue 1)
blurb: League clash with Marseille at Parc OL, one of French football's biggest rivalries; kick-off time still to be set.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (Ligue 1 matchday 14; kick-off time to be confirmed)

name: Olympique Lyonnais v Union Saint-Gilloise (UEFA Europa League)
blurb: Thursday-night Europa League game at the OL Stadium.
when: Thu 10 Dec 2026, 21:00 (league phase, matchday 6)

name: Nice Christmas Village (Village de Noël)
blurb: Christmas village in the Jardin Albert 1er and on Place Masséna, open every day and free to enter.
when: 27 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027, open daily

name: OGC Nice v RC Lens (Ligue 1)
blurb: Saturday league game at the Allianz Riviera, west of the city; kick-off time to be set by the league.
when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (Ligue 1 matchday 14; kick-off time to be confirmed)

name: Foire aux santons (Christmas figurine fair), Old Port
blurb: Marseille's oldest santons fair, founded in 1803: 21 craftsmen selling hand-made Provençal nativity figures along the Old Port.
when: 14 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027, Vieux-Port (Quai du Port)

name: Olympique de Marseille v Celta Vigo (UEFA Europa League)
blurb: Thursday Europa League game at the Stade Vélodrome, famous for its atmosphere.
when: Thu 10 Dec 2026, 18:45 (league phase, matchday 6)

name: Olympique de Marseille v OGC Nice (Ligue 1)
blurb: Saturday league game at the Vélodrome; kick-off time to be set by the league.
when: Sat 5 Dec 2026 (Ligue 1 matchday 13; kick-off time to be confirmed)

name: Christkindlimarkt at Zürich Main Station
blurb: Covered market in the station hall under a huge tree, with 100+ stalls and light effects overhead; easy to reach on arrival.
when: 19 Nov-24 Dec 2026

name: The Singing Christmas Tree (Werdmühleplatz)
blurb: Christmas market where more than 40 choirs sing on a tree-shaped stage, with daily free concerts and a fondue chalet.
when: 19 Nov-23 Dec 2026; choirs sing daily from 17:30

name: ZSC Lions v SC Bern (National League ice hockey)
blurb: Friday-night ice hockey at the Swiss Life Arena against SC Bern, one of the league's big names; kick-off 19:45.
when: Fri 18 Dec 2026, 19:45 (home games also Sat 5 Dec v SCL Tigers)

name: Lichterschwimmen (lantern float on the Limmat)
blurb: Hundreds of tiny school-made lanterns set off down the Limmat at 18:00; hot punch is served for onlookers at Weinplatz.
when: Thu 17 Dec 2026, 18:00 from Stadthausquai

name: Fête de l'Escalade (historic weekend)
blurb: Geneva's biggest historical festival: costumed Compagnie de 1602 parades through the Old Town marking the 1602 night attack.
when: Fri 11-Sun 13 Dec 2026

name: Course de l'Escalade (road race)
blurb: Switzerland's most popular road race through Geneva's old town; run it or just watch the crowds.
priceText: CHF 42 for adult runs of 4.8 or 7.3 km; CHF 37 for the evening Marmite run; watching is free
when: Sat 5 and Sun 6 Dec 2026; adult runs from 10:40 on Sat, evening Marmite run 18:50

name: Noël au Quai (Christmas market on the Quai du Mont-Blanc)
blurb: Lakeside Christmas market on the Quai du Mont-Blanc, open into the evening (until 23:00 on Fridays and Saturdays).

name: Basler Weihnachtsmarkt (Barfüsserplatz and Münsterplatz)
blurb: One of Switzerland's prettiest Christmas markets, split between Barfüsserplatz and the cathedral square, plus a fairy-tale forest.

name: FC Basel v Servette FC (Super League)
blurb: Sunday-afternoon league game at St. Jakob-Park, Basel's big stadium.
when: Weekend of 5-6 Dec 2026 (official league schedule); fixture sites list Sun 6 Dec, 14:00

name: Imagine Peace Tower (nightly light beam from Viðey)
blurb: Yoko Ono's beam of light rises from Viðey Island every evening in December; watch it from the Reykjavík waterfront.
when: Lit nightly 1-30 Dec, 18:00-midnight (31 Dec until morning)

name: Hafnarfjörður Christmas Village (Jólaþorpið)
blurb: Little village of Christmas huts south of Reykjavík with live music, visits from the Yule Lads and horse-drawn carriage rides.
when: Usually every Saturday and Sunday 12:00-17:00 during Advent; 2026 dates not yet published

name: Reykjavík city-centre Christmas markets and Ingólfstorg ice rink
blurb: December markets around Austurvöllur and Hjartatorg plus a skating rink on Ingólfstorg, a few minutes' walk apart.
priceText: Free entry to markets; ice rink is ticketed
when: December; 2026 dates not yet published (2025: Hjartatorg market 5-6, 12-13, 18-23 Dec)
